description: Turn on more Discord tools for this conversation. Only the core tools are on at first; call this as soon as a task needs one of these packs: automations (role menus, welcome messages with auto-roles, support tickets and their history, the server's own slash commands, staff slash commands (/ban, /lock, /purge…), moderation logs and searching them, staff alerts, support forums, rules (when X happens do Y), member verification, scheduled messages); live (what is happening now, waiting for a reply, mention or join); jobs (background jobs: message backups and restores, roles for many members at once); moderation (AutoMod, locking channels, purging messages, bans list, pruning, audit log, role audit, member export); messaging (webhooks (post with another name), DMs, pins list, announcements publishing, polls and reactions results); organizing (cloning channels, more forum tags, threads, following announcement channels, copying and syncing permissions); server_settings (onboarding, welcome screen, invites list, server stats and activity, bot profile, creating or leaving servers); expressions (emojis, stickers, soundboard, scheduled events, stage, application commands); insights (mapping a server's areas and projects, collecting feedback from forums, tickets and channels, and feedback reports (tone, open bugs, repeated requests, themes), also from exported files); api (direct Discord API calls for anything else).
name: enable_tools
